title: Deep Neural Sheaf Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2605.19021v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Deep Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are essential for capturing complex dependencies in graph-structured data. However, scaling GNNs to depth remains challenging, as stacking layers leads to representation collapse and diminishing sensitivity due to repeated aggregation. While Neural Sheaf Diffusion (NSD) provides strong theoretical guarantees against such collapse, these guarantees do not translate to practice: as depth increases, the disagreement signal of the sheaf Laplacian vanishes, limiting the contribution of deeper layers. We identify mechanisms that hinder NSD effectiveness at depth and propose \emph{Deep Neural Sheaf Diffusion} (DNSD), which replaces the sheaf Laplacian with a sheaf adjacency operator to maintain informative signals across layers. translated_abstract: 深度图神经网络（GNN）对于捕捉图结构数据中的复杂依赖关系至关重要。然而，将GNN扩展到更深的层次仍然具有挑战性，因为堆叠层数会由于重复聚合而导致表示坍塌和敏感性递减。虽然神经层束扩散提供了对抗此类坍塌的强大理论保证，但这些保证在实践中并未兑现：随着深度增加，层束拉普拉斯算子的不一致信号逐渐消失，限制了更深层的贡献。我们识别了阻碍NSD在深层有效的机制，并提出深度神经层束扩散（DNSD），用层束邻接算子替代层束拉普拉斯算子，以在各层之间保持有信息量的信号。这辅以归一化、奇非线性激活和门控机制作为补充。为了对预期的性能提升提供有原则的解释，我们将层束扩散与图……
tldr: 提出深度神经层束扩散（DNSD），用层束邻接算子替代层束拉普拉斯算子，并配合归一化、奇非线性和门控机制，解决深层网络中层束信号消失的问题，使图神经网络能够有效扩展到更深的层次。
en_tdlr: Proposes Deep Neural Sheaf Diffusion (DNSD), which replaces the sheaf Laplacian with a sheaf adjacency operator, complemented by normalization, odd nonlinearities, and gating, to maintain informative signals across layers and enable effective deep graph neural networks.
